name: form-tabs
title: Form tabs
description: A long form split across tabs that still submits as one: errors show on the tab, and a field inside a hidden panel is revealed before it is focused.
docs: Put FormTabs inside your form. Every panel stays in the page, so one form sends everything and values survive a switch of tab. When a submit fails the browser cannot focus a field in a hidden panel and stays silent; FormTabs takes the first invalid field over, opens its tab, focuses it and asks the browser to point at it. A tab with problems says "Pricing, 2 problems" with the number beside the name, and a thin line under the tabs fills with the share of tabs that are clean. Problems are counted from the browser's own validation (required, pattern, min) once a submit fails, and update as fields are fixed. Pass errorCounts, keyed by tab id, for what only your server knows; it wins for the tabs it names. value and onValueChange control the tab. In a narrow form (under 19 rem) the tabs tighten so three with a count still fit; when they do not, the strip scrolls, fades at the end that has more and brings the tab that opens into view, also when a failed submit opened it. A field in a hidden Radix Select is not focusable: put required on text-like inputs.
